name: Anemoy Tokenized Apollo Diversified Credit Fund
oneLiner: ACRDX is a permissioned, NAV-accreting share token from Anemoy and Centrifuge giving on-chain access to Apollo's diversified private credit strategy.
collateral: Tokenized feeder exposure to Apollo Diversified Credit Fund through the Anemoy Tokenized Apollo Diversified Credit Fund Segregated Portfolio, investing across corporate direct lending, asset-backed lending, performing credit, and dislocated credit.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting fund share rather than a fixed $1 token; primary subscriptions and redemptions are permissioned at fund NAV.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: ACRDX is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

yieldConfig.yieldSource: Anemoy Apollo Diversified Credit Fund NAV

notices.title: Separate Apollo credit wrapper
notices.message: ACRDX overlaps economically with ACRED private-credit exposure, but uses a distinct Anemoy / Centrifuge issuer route and token contract set.
